verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage gives an automated onboarding flow machine-readable results to branch on. The `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED` webhook payload carries a `customer-screening.step_output.screening_result` field indicating whether hits were found, and synchronous screening suits real-time onboarding. Customers get a configurable risk score, and cases, alerts and risks are exposed via the API with enumerated decisions ('no risk detected', 'risk detected- accepted', 'risk detected- offboard'), all documented in a retrievable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema. missing for 10: explicit documented failure/reason codes for why a check flagged, field-level detail on risk-signal payloads, and hands-on corroboration of actual response contents.
